The arrow-read cases (sites.go, chainRv2hv and derefContext): how many
rv2hv perl builds for a `->{...}` chain, by the chain's keys and by what is
done with the dereference around it. A modified `@{}` or `%{}` keeps every
brace level of the last run out of multideref; a computed key keeps its own
level's rv2hv unless the run before it folded. Each snippet is measured on
perl 5.44.0 with -MO=Concise. The wider rows are the hedges that remain,
each named in TestArrowHashReadHedgesNameTheirShape.

=== plain read
my $h; my $x = $h->{a};
--- facts
faithful

=== two levels
my $h; my $x = $h->{a}{b};
--- facts
faithful

=== three levels
my $h; my $x = $h->{a}{b}{c};
--- facts
faithful

=== scalar key
my $h; my $k; my $x = $h->{$k};
--- facts
faithful

=== interpolated key
my $h; my $b; my $x = $h->{"a$b"};
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== array level after a hash level
my $h; my $x = $h->{a}->[0];
--- facts
faithful

=== $$h{a}
my $h; my $x = $$h{a};
--- facts
faithful

=== ${$h}{a}
my $h; my $x = ${$h}{a};
--- facts
# canon re-emits `${$h}{a}` as `$$h{a}`, so no faithful row

=== postfix slice
my $h; my @x = $h->@{qw(a b)};
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== exists two levels
my $h; exists $h->{a}{b};
--- facts
faithful

=== delete
my $h; delete $h->{a};
--- facts
faithful

=== local element
my $h; local $h->{a};
--- facts
faithful

=== postincrement element
my $h; $h->{a}++;
--- facts
faithful

=== call key
my $h; my $x = $h->{f()};
--- facts
rv2hv 1 wider
faithful

=== negated bareword key
my $h; my $x = $h->{-bareword};
--- facts
faithful

=== assign through an undefined ref
my $x; $x->{a} = 1;
--- facts
faithful

=== whole hash deref
my $h; my %x = %$h;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== keys of a hash deref
my $h; keys %$h;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== shift key
my $r; my $x = $r->{shift()};
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== element as a sub argument
my $r; foo($r->{a});
--- facts
faithful

=== hash deref of an element as a sub argument
my $r; foo(%{$r->{a}});
--- facts
rv2hv 2 exact
faithful

=== hash deref of an element in list assignment
my $r; my @x = %{$r->{a}};
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== keys of a deref element
my $r; keys %{$r->{a}};
--- facts
rv2hv 2 exact
faithful

=== push onto a deref element
my $r; push @{$r->{a}}, 1;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== push onto a two-level chain
my $s; my $k; push @{$s->{x}{$k}}, 1;
--- facts
rv2hv 2 exact
faithful

=== push after a computed last key
my $r; push @{$r->{a}{"x$r"}}, 1;
--- facts
faithful

=== push after a computed first key
my $r; push @{$r->{"x$r"}{a}}, 1;
--- facts
rv2hv 2 exact
faithful

=== local element assigned
my $r; local $r->{a} = 1;
--- facts
faithful

=== reference to an element
my $r; my $x = \$r->{a};
--- facts
srefgen 1 exact
faithful

=== foreach over an element
my $r; for ($r->{a}) {}
--- facts
faithful

=== exists
my $r; exists $r->{a}{b};
--- facts
faithful

=== delete two levels
my $r; delete $r->{a}{b};
--- facts
faithful

=== last index of a deref element
my $r; my $x = $#{$r->{a}};
--- facts
rv2hv 1 wider
faithful

=== array deref of an element read
my $r; my @x = @{$r->{a}};
--- facts
faithful

=== foreach over a deref element
my $r; foreach (@{$r->{a}}) {}
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== assign to a deref element
my $r; @{$r->{a}} = (1);
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== scalar deref read
my $r; my $x = ${$r->{a}};
--- facts
faithful

=== scalar deref assigned
my $r; ${$r->{a}} = 1;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== scalar deref incremented after a folded level
my $r; ${$r->{a}{b}}++;
--- facts
faithful

=== scalar deref incremented from @_
${$_[0]->{a}}++;
--- facts
faithful

=== deref element as a sub argument
my $r; foo(@{$r->{a}});
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== chomp
my $r; chomp(@{$r->{a}});
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== grep list
my $r; my @x = grep { 1 } @{$r->{a}};
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== map list
my $r; my @x = map { 1 } @{$r->{a}};
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== sprintf list
my $r; my $x = sprintf "%s", @{$r->{a}};
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== method arguments
my $r; my $o; $o->m(@{$r->{a}});
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== postfix deref read
my $r; my @x = $r->{a}->@*;
--- facts
faithful

=== postfix deref pushed
my $r; push $r->{a}->@*, 1;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== sort without a block reads
my $r; my @x = sort @{$r->{a}};
--- facts
faithful

=== sort with a block modifies
my $r; my @x = sort { 1 } @{$r->{a}};
--- facts
rv2hv 1 wider
faithful

=== condition
my $r; if (@{$r->{a}}) {}
--- facts
faithful

=== statement modifier condition
my $r; print 1 if @{$r->{a}};
--- facts
faithful

=== arithmetic
my $r; my $x = 2 * @{$r->{a}} + @{$r->{b}};
--- facts
faithful

=== reference to a deref element
my $r; my $x = \@{$r->{a}};
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
srefgen 1 exact
faithful

=== array slice of a deref element
my $r; my @x = @{$r->{a}}[0,1];
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== hash slice of a deref element
my $r; my @x = @{$r->{a}}{qw(a b)};
--- facts
rv2hv 2 exact
faithful

=== element of a scalar deref
my $r; my $x = ${$r->{a}}[0];
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== element key after a folded run
my $r; my $x = $r->{$x->{y}};
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== computed key after an array level
my $r; my $x = $r->[0]{2*$_[0]};
--- facts
faithful

=== two computed keys
my $r; my $x = $r->{"x$r"}{"y$r"};
--- facts
rv2hv 2 exact
faithful

=== constant sub key folds
sub f(){1} my $r; my $x = $r->{f()};
--- facts
faithful
